# coop-msa_v2-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-saturation-low

<!-- Generated by tools/export_results.py. Edit only the Experiment and Observations sections. -->

## Experiment

Runs `coop` with messaging only (two agents, one feature each, no shared git remote) on the 50-pair `flash` subset with the same setup as [`coop --git` at `low` thinking](../coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-saturation-low/summary.md) (`gemini-3.8-flash`, 500 steps, compaction at 64K tokens, step counter, `$40` per-agent cost cap). Comparing the two isolates what the shared git remote adds. On the 10-pair `flash_10` subset both scored 8/10, too few pairs to tell them apart. It ran as two 25-pair halves on two API keys and was merged into this one run.

## Observations

- 32/50 (64%) with messaging only vs. 30/50 for `coop --git` in both of its runs. The shared git remote did not raise the score; the difference is within run-to-run variation. Against `solo` at `low` (36/50), every pair this run passed was also passed by `solo` (4 losses, no wins).
- Without shared git, both `pallets_click_task/2068` pairs passed ((6,7) and (7,10)), which failed in both `coop --git` runs. In `coop --git`, the agents could see their branches would conflict on the shared `Editor(...)` call, agreed to route around it, and broke hidden tests. Here, without that view, one agent changed the shared call for both features (on (6,7) it passes both `escape_shell` and `process_priority`), and the branches still merged cleanly. `pallets_click_task/2068` (5,11) went the other way: it hit a merge conflict here and failed.
- Merges: 43 clean, 4 identical branches, 3 conflicts (vs. 0 to 2 with shared git). One conflicting pair (`typst_task/6554` (7,8)) still passed through the grader's fallback of testing agent 1's branch alone.
- Agents exchanged more messages without shared git: median 38.5 per pair vs. 28 with it, since describing changes in chat replaces looking at each other's branches. No agent reached the 500-step limit (median 106.5 steps per agent). Cost `$49.49` vs. `$39.85`.
